clip_worthy_moments.quote: Time is the valuable asset here, right? And nobody has time.

episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the current trends in the luxury real estate market, emphasizing the importance of understanding market dynamics and client needs. She highlights the role of AI in real estate and shares strategies for pricing and selling homes effectively. The episode also covers the significance of maintaining client relationships post-sale through personalized communication.
